input: Which customers on Feeder 4 should receive proactive SMS notifications about the tree-related power outage?
expected_output:
### Executive Summary
**A total of 1,180 active customer accounts downstream of Feeder 4 are impacted by the verified tree-related fault event and qualify for proactive SMS notifications.** **Priority messaging is partitioned across Medical/Life Support accounts (18), Key Commercial/Industrial accounts (42), and standard Residential opt-ins (1,120), with an initial Estimated Time to Restoration (ETR) set to 120 minutes.** **In accordance with utility regulatory mandates and safety protocols, all customer PII has been redacted and mass SMS broadcast requires Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) authorization prior to dispatch.**

---

### Quantitative Evaluation & Customer Cohort Breakdown

| Metric | Current Value | Baseline / Target | Delta (%) | Status (Normal/Warning/Critical) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Total Feeder 4 Meter Points** | 1,425 meters | 1,425 meters | 0.0% | Normal |
| **De-energized Meters (Impacted)** | 1,180 meters | 0 meters | N/A | **Critical** |
| **SMS Opt-In Coverage** | 94.9% (1,120 res / 1,180) | 85.0% target | +11.6% | Normal |
| **Critical Care / Life Support Accounts** | 18 accounts | 0 baseline | N/A | **Critical** |
| **Commercial / Essential Accounts** | 42 accounts | 0 baseline | N/A | **Warning** |
| **Predicted SAIDI Impact (Feeder 4)** | 99.3 min | < 60.0 min target | +65.5% | **Warning** |
| **Initial Dispatch ETR Accuracy Target** | 120 min | ± 15 min tolerance | 0.0% | Normal |

---

### Notification Cohort Segmentation & Payload Configuration

1. **Cohort 1: Critical Care / Medical Baseline (18 Accounts)**
   - **Channel Priority**: High-priority SMS + Automated Voice Escalation fallback.
   - **Template Payload**: `[UTILITY ALERT] Service interruption detected on Feeder 4 affecting your address. Cause: Tree on lines. Crew dispatched. Initial ETR: 2 hrs. If you require emergency medical life support power assistance, please execute your emergency backup plan or call emergency services.`

2. **Cohort 2: Key Commercial & Industrial (42 Accounts)**
   - **Channel Priority**: SMS + Designated Key Account Representative Notification.
   - **Template Payload**: `[UTILITY COMMERCE ALERT] Outage detected at Feeder 4 service drop. Vegetation management & line crews are en route. Current ETR: 2 hours. Account rep notification initiated.`

3. **Cohort 3: Residential SMS Opt-In (1,120 Accounts)**
   - **Channel Priority**: Standard Omnichannel SMS.
   - **Template Payload**: `[UTILITY OUTAGE UPDATE] We are aware of a power outage in your area (Feeder 4) caused by fallen tree limbs. Repair crews have been assigned. Estimated restoration time is 2 hours. Track progress at [LINK]. Reply STOP to opt out.`

- **Immediate Broadcast**: Authorize Tier 2 execution of the outbound proactive SMS broadcast across all 1,180 validated contacts on Feeder 4.
- **Vegetation Management Telemetry Sync**: Monitor live field crew ingress (Vegetation Crew #12) and dynamically recalculate ETR if line clearing exceeds the 45-minute benchmark.
- **Cadence Frequency**: Schedule downstream interval updates every 60 minutes or immediately upon 50% restoration milestone.

input: What is the estimated reduction in call center inbound volume achieved by proactive outage notifications during storm events?
expected_output:
### 1. Executive Summary
**Implementing proactive, multi-stage outage SMS notifications during major storm events achieves an estimated 65% to 75% reduction in inbound customer call center volume.** **By preemptively pushing real-time outage confirmation, automated Estimated Time to Restoration (ETR) updates, and crew dispatch status directly to affected customers, utilities significantly mitigate peak IVR queue saturation and prevent repeat "no-information" inquiries.** **This proactive deflection lowers overall cost-to-serve during storm operations while improving customer satisfaction (CSAT) and regulatory compliance posture under high-stress grid conditions.**

---

### 2. Data Presentation

The operational metrics below benchmark customer contact deflection and call center load dynamics under standard storm operating conditions when comparing proactive SMS workflows against legacy reactive channels.

| Metric | Current Value | Baseline / Target | Delta (%) | Status (Normal/Warning/Critical) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Inbound Call Rate (per 10k Affected Customers)** | 1,150 calls | 4,200 calls | -72.6% | Normal |
| **First Contact Resolution (FCR) Deflection via SMS** | 68.4% | 20.0% | +242.0% | Normal |
| **Average Speed of Answer (ASA) in Queue** | 84 sec | 380 sec | -77.9% | Normal |
| **Repeat Call Volume (Same Incident)** | 12.5% | 46.2% | -72.9% | Normal |
| **SMS Delivery Success Rate (within 10 min of Outage)** | 97.8% | 95.0% | +2.9% | Normal |
| **ETR Accuracy Deviation (< 30 min variance)** | 86.2% | 80.0% | +7.8% | Normal |

---

### 3. Visualization Triggers

**Recommended Chart Type:** Bar Chart / Multi-Interval Impact Comparison  
**Description:** Inbound Call Deflection & Queue Load Comparison Across Communication Modes.

```json
{
  "chart_type": "bar",
  "title": "Call Center Inbound Volume per 10k Outages by Notification Strategy",
  "data": [
    {
      "strategy": "Baseline (Reactive / No SMS)",
      "inbound_calls": 4200,
      "deflection_rate_pct": 0.0
    },
    {

      "inbound_calls": 2600,

    },
    {

    }

}
```

---

### 4. Actionable Recommendations

- **Maintain Dynamic ETR Publishing Cadence:** Ensure the Outage Management System (OMS) automatically pushes refreshed ETR updates via SMS whenever an assigned restoration window changes by more than $\pm 30$ minutes.
- **Implement Nested Customer Segmenting:** Prioritize critical-care and life-support customers with personalized two-way verification SMS workflows ahead of broad geographic feeder-level blasts.
- **Deploy Two-Way Status Interactivity:** Enable self-service keywords (e.g., `STATUS`, `RESTORED`, `UPDATE`) to prevent secondary calling when localized power restoration verification is needed.
- **Rate-Limit SMS Burst Queuing:** Throttle batch SMS gateway dispatch to align with carrier throughput limits to ensure messages land within 5–10 minutes of initial Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) last-gasp detection.

---

}
